lead: The coverage gates read a case's `--FILE--` alone, so a class named only in the `--TEST--` title attributes nothing.
body: `Attribution::holders` attributes a `->member(` only to classes named in the body or a registered return type. Write the receiver's class name inside the body, in a comment if nowhere else, or `every_part_one_member_has_a_conformance_case` fails naming the member.
